parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$2r+r\theta=65$ and $\tfrac12r^2\theta=225$ — B1.
Form a three-term quadratic or cubic in $r$ or $\theta$ from correct arc and sector formulae — M1*. Condone sign errors.
Solve their three-term quadratic or cubic to obtain values of $r$ or $\theta$ — DM1. Expect $2r^2-65r+450=(2r-45)(r-10)$ or $18\theta^2-97\theta+72=(9\theta-8)(2\theta-9)$.
$r=10$ and $\theta=4.5$ — A1. Ignore $r=22.5$ and $\theta=8/9$; do not ignore $r=0$. B1 SC if no quadratic or cubic solution; if $r=0$ included, A0 or B0 SC.
Total: 4.
